chunk.text: What is wrong, Tofu?

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: I don't want to go to school today.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Jim and Jerry took all the tokens I had collected for the charity

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: and submitted it as their own.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Now they are going to win the appreciation sticker.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Don't worry about it, Tofu.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Sometimes it's okay to let go of things and just hold on to the joy they brought to you.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: I don't know, Tia.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Do you know a nice story to help me believe?

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Sure. I'll tell you a story.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: A Poor Farmer

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Once upon a time, a poor farmer was plowing his field.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: When he hit something hard, it was a large metal pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: What's this? A metal pot?

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: I wonder if there is something more valuable underneath.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: In the hope that he could find something more valuable, the farmer dug deeper and wider.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Tired after hours of searching, the farmer decided to rest.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: He left his bed in the pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: And lay down under the tree.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: A while later, when he got up and went back to the pot,

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: he was surprised.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: How is this possible? The pot is full of hundreds of spades.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: I had left only one in it.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Looks like this is a magical pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Let me see what will happen if I put a mango in it.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The farmer was surprised.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: And just as the farmer had thought, the one mango turned into hundreds of mangoes

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: when he left it in the pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: This is truly a magical pot. I will take it home and use it to tide over our troubles.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The farmer went home and hit the pot at a safe place.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: He then went to the market and sold the mangoes.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: He earned a handsome sum for them.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: On the way back, he brought some grains.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: He went home and put each one of them in the pot one by one.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Soon he had enough of grains to last his family for the rest of the year.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The farmer called his wife and told her everything that had happened.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: This is a blessing. We should use it wisely to become rich but also keep it safely hidden.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The farmer agreed with his wife.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Over the year, he slowly started putting things in the pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Fruits, vegetables, textiles,

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: and in some years, he turned around his family's fortune.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Though they had been secretive and very careful about their magic pot,

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: people started noticing how they had become rich.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: And soon their secret was out.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: It even reached the king's ears.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Such a powerful magical pot should be a part of the king's secret.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The king's secret was a secret.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The king's secret was a secret.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The king's secret was a secret.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Such a powerful magical pot should be a part of the king's treasury.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The farmer has no right to keep it. Only I have the right to own that pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The king ordered the soldier to bring the pot to the palace.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The soldier stormed into the farmer's home.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: And confiscated the pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: They brought it to the king.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Let me see what is inside the pot that makes it so magical.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Once I find what it is, I will become a hundred times more powerful.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The king peered over the pot and looked into it.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: As he did, he lost his balance and fell into the pot.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: As he fell, he hit his head on the edge of the pot and became unconscious.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: When he woke up, he saw that there were hundreds of kings like him.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: They all fought each other to get to the throne.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: And died.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Soon the news reached the farmer and his wife.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Should we get the pot back now?

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: The king was foolish and his curiosity killed him.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: But it is not safe to keep the pot anymore.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: We have enough money and riches to take care of us and our many next generations.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Let us lead the pot within the king's treasury.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Oh thank you dear.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: That was indeed an inspiring story.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: And I feel much better now letting go of those tokens.

chunk.title: THE MAGIC POT STORY  STORIES FOR KIDS  TRADITIONAL STORY
chunk.text: Good to know that Tufu.
